comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
The dark brown color of the gloves can be obtained for completing the "Invitation to a Banquet" quests, one of the next to last quests for completing the Prince Henrique storyline. Stats:

Sociability +2
Spice Trading +1
Metal Trading +1

Requires 5k fame to equip, unisex.

wiki: How to Obtain: Invitation to a Banquet
